milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted_dandelion is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 4). The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they've found it. Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance.
Uses inventory_has because mining a bed drops the bed item into the player's inventory. Purple bed when mined drops as a purple_bed item.
Uses inventory_has because mining black_wool drops the black_wool block item into the player's inventory.
Uses inventory_has because mining a dark_oak_fence_gate drops the fence gate item into the player's inventory.
Uses inventory_has because mining cobblestone_wall drops the cobblestone_wall item into the player's inventory. The player needs to mine at least 1 block from the wall at z=-9.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because building a window means placing glass_pane blocks in the opening created by mining the cobblestone_wall. The wall opening is at spawn-relative x=-1 to 1, y=1 to 2, z=-9. Using a generous box ±3 around that area to detect at least 2 glass_pane blocks placed.
Uses inventory_has because crafting a bow (3 sticks + 3 string in crafting table) results in the bow appearing in the player's inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The ice spikes formation is centered around the tallest pillar at spawn-relative (-10, 3, 1). The player must navigate near the ice spike pillars and face them. Using max_distance=10 to allow viewing from a reasonable distance.
Uses inventory_has because mining chiseled_polished_blackstone with a pickaxe drops the block item into the player's inventory.

Uses inventory_has because after repairing the iron pickaxe on the anvil with iron ingots, the repaired pickaxe remains in inventory. The player starts with a damaged iron_pickaxe (Damage:200). After repair it still shows as iron_pickaxe in inventory. Since the player already has the pickaxe, we check that iron_ingots have been consumed (player starts with 2, after repair should have 0 or fewer). We use inventory_has for the pickaxe to confirm it's still present, combined with verifying the repair action occurred.

Uses inventory_has because crafting birch_slab (birch_logs → birch_planks → birch_slabs) results in birch_slab items appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with birch_logs but no birch_slabs.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because building a trap involves placing a stone_pressure_plate as the trigger mechanism in the trap area (around spawn-relative x=-2 to 2, z=5 to 10). The pressure plate is the key functional component that makes it a 'trap' - detecting when an entity steps on it. Checking for at least 1 stone_pressure_plate placed in the trap area.
